problem.observed: Screen 2 receives only side, depth-ten imbalance, pressure status, and snapshot count for the v51 HIP-3 routes.
problem.root_cause: The durable observer journal did not serialize completed-candle breakout levels or EMA geometry, so the executable provider could not project those facts into readiness telemetry.
problem.impact: The backend still made authoritative decisions correctly, but the operator could not see whether price breakout, EMA alignment, or pressure confirmation was nearest to firing without a separate report-only diagnostic.
problem.capital_risk: No direct capital defect was identified; this is an observability and attribution gap.

implementation.journal_contract: New rows optionally carry condition_anatomy with close, prior 32-bar high/low, EMA21/55, and exact long/short raw states.
implementation.provider_contract: The live adapter validates the nested facts against the frozen 32-bar, EMA21/55, and absolute 0.10 pressure logic before exposing them.
screen2_indicators: completed close and prior breakout levels
signed basis-point distance to the high and low breakout levels
implementation.legacy_behavior: Rows written before this revision remain accepted and are explicitly labeled legacy_or_warmup_unavailable rather than fabricating geometry.
implementation.behavioral_invariant: Eligibility, side, intent construction, entry timing, sizing, stops, profit locks, maximum holds, routing, and execution authority are unchanged.

current_runtime_boundary.deployment_decision: Do not restart a healthy protected live process solely for additive telemetry. Load the coordinated observer and backend revision at the next safe flat and order-free restart boundary.
current_runtime_boundary.expected_until_restart: Screen 2 continues to show the existing four HIP-3 indicators; offline condition diagnostics remain the current source of detailed geometry.

validation.standards: all three production files are at most 500 lines and all functions are at most 50 lines
covered_cases: new completed-bar anatomy reaches provider readiness
observer decision construction records exact signal values
generic TUI readiness detail renders proximity indicators

confidence: High confidence in the additive serialization, validation, and readiness path from focused and broader tests; medium confidence in the next deployed TUI observation until a post-restart 15-minute decision is written and rendered.
falsifier: Reject this implementation if a post-restart row lacks condition_anatomy after indicator warmup, observer and backend values differ at the same decision boundary, any authoritative eligible/side result changes solely because of telemetry, a legacy row becomes unreadable, or Screen 2 fails to display the new indicators after selecting the exact provider row.
next_validation: At the next safe flat and order-free coordinated restart, require one new row per symbol, exact observer/backend anatomy parity, and a 160-column Screen 2 render containing PX, EMA21/55, and TO HIGH/TO LOW indicators.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Continue collecting the first attributable SPCX long decision and lifecycle while resolving the existing SP500 and SPCX short lifecycles; this telemetry improvement does not replace that economic evidence objective.
